watches: Morning watch: names and the Canon

canon.kamu: multiply: i <- i x a (pairwise, or by a's last value)
canon.kagi: greatest common divisor of the values of i
canon.kapi: primes up to i's last value
canon.kapo: power: i <- i ^ a's last value
canon.kamo: product of all values of i
canon.pari: interior angle of a regular polygon with i sides (degrees)
canon.paso: star polygon {n/k}: the visiting order of its points (i = n, a = k)
canon.pamo: first seven resonant frequencies of a cube room of side i metres (Hz)
canon.pahe: Heron: area of a triangle with sides i[0], i[1], i[2]
canon.bari: Fibonacci numbers up to i's last value
canon.basa: triangular numbers T1..Tn, n = i's last value
canon.baro: distinct values, in order of first appearance
canon.bato: take the first n values (n = #number, default 3)
canon.dami: sing i as a melody (folded to the octave)
canon.maro: the seven string ratios (a e y i o u w)
canon.maki: interval in cents from i[0] to each value
canon.raso: celestial phase stamp: seven mean longitudes for J2000 + i days
canon.rado: planetary weekday of J2000 + i days (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday)

meta.prelude:
::kemu kua | kw #0 | lu :keso | kiw ::
::keso bwi nu #1 gw ::
::kegi la :keto ::
::keto kei kia kae mea ::
::kehi kyi | ko #1 | ly :keho | kio ::
::keho kio :kemu ny #1 koi kay ::

steps.title: The middle string
steps.aid: i is Sunday, the Sun, the middle string: the accumulator where results gather. k is the first month (Nisan) and means keep.
steps.say: kee gm
steps.explain: Keep the number 5 in plane i. A number always follows its word after #.
steps.task: Keep 7 in i.

steps.title: The door
steps.aid: d is Av, the month of the door: what is in a plane goes out through d.
steps.say: kee gm dee
steps.explain: Two words in a verse run in the order written. di sends i out.
steps.task: Send 9 out of the door.

steps.title: Stream and breath
steps.aid: s is Shevat, the stream: count from one. | is a breath, the end of a verse.
steps.say: see mm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: si #7 fills i with 1 to 7. The breath ends the verse; the next verse sends i out.
steps.task: Count 1 to 4 and send it out.

steps.title: Counting in twelves
steps.aid: Numbers are base twelve: t is ten, e is eleven, #10 is twelve. Twelve stones, twelve months, twelve digits.
steps.say: kee tm-km (breathe) dee
steps.explain: #10 means one twelve and no units: 12.
steps.task: Keep 23 (one twelve and eleven).

steps.title: The Moon plane, and the closing vowel
steps.aid: a is Monday, the Moon: the input plane. A lone vowel at the end of a word names the plane it draws from.
steps.say: sah gm (breathe) kee-ah (breathe) dee
steps.explain: sa #5 fills a; kia keeps into i a copy of a (the closing a is the source).
steps.task: Fill a with 1 to 3 and copy it into i.

steps.title: Gather
steps.aid: g is Elul, the month of gathering the harvest: g adds a plane up.
steps.say: sah gm (breathe) gee-ah (breathe) dee
steps.explain: gia gathers a into i: 1+2+3+4+5 = 15.
steps.task: Gather 1 to 10 into i.

steps.title: Test
steps.aid: t is Iyyar, the test: keep only what is above a number.
steps.say: see mm (breathe) tee bm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: ti #3 keeps the values of i above 3.
steps.task: Keep the values of 1 to 9 that are above 6.

steps.title: Negate
steps.aid: n is Kislev, the month of the longest nights: it subtracts, or with no number turns a value to its negative.
steps.say: see gm (breathe) nee tm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: ni #1 takes 1 from every value of i.
steps.task: Take 2 from each of 1 to 4.

steps.title: Project
steps.aid: p is Sivan, the projection: multiply by a number, or by a string's ratio (pia = by 4:3, the fourth).
steps.say: see bm (breathe) pee pm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: pi #2 doubles every value of i.
steps.task: Triple 1 to 3.

steps.title: Retro
steps.aid: r is Tevet, turning back: reverse the order.
steps.say: see gm (breathe) ree (breathe) dee
steps.explain: ri reverses i.
steps.task: Make 4 3 2 1.

steps.title: Bind
steps.aid: b is Tammuz, binding: join another plane onto the end.
steps.say: see bm (breathe) sah pm (breathe) bee-ah (breathe) dee
steps.explain: bia binds a onto the end of i: 1 2 3 1 2.
steps.task: Join 1 to 2 (in a) onto 1 to 3 (in i).

steps.title: Morph
steps.aid: m is Cheshvan: morph. With a number it wraps values round like a clock (the remainder).
steps.say: see rm (breathe) mee dm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: mi #4 replaces each value by its remainder after dividing by 4.
steps.task: Show 1 to 7 on a clock of 3.

steps.title: Hold
steps.aid: h is Adar, the last month: hold your breath and count. hia counts the values of a.
steps.say: sah rm (breathe) hee-ah (breathe) dee
steps.explain: hia puts the number of values in a into i.
steps.task: Count the values of 1 to 11 in a.

steps.title: The other five days
steps.aid: e Wednesday (Mercury, scratch) · y Friday (Venus, pair) · o Tuesday (Mars, output) · u Thursday (Jupiter, store) · w Saturday (Saturn, archive).
steps.say: soh dm (breathe) saw pm (breathe) kee-oh (breathe) bee-aw (breathe) dee
steps.explain: Seven planes now: fill o and w, copy o into i, bind w on.
steps.task: Fill u with 1 to 6 and gather it into i.

steps.title: The ring
steps.aid: A verse is read like a chiasm: first with last, second with second-last, and the centre word last of all.
steps.say: sah mm gee-ah tah bm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: Ring order runs sa, then ta (the outer pair), then gia (the centre): 4+5+6+7 = 22. Written sa #7 ta #3 gia, the same words give 28.
steps.task: Make the centre gather run before the test: get 28.

steps.title: Spelling a sequence
steps.aid: To run A B C D in that order, write A C D B: begin and end together, then the middle.
steps.say: see dm ree dee pee pm
steps.explain: Written si ri di pi, it runs si, pi, ri, di: 1 to 4, doubled, reversed, out: 8 6 4 2.
steps.task: Run: stream 1 to 3, then reverse, then double.

steps.title: A word is a pipeline
steps.aid: Inside a word, the syllables act one after another on the word's own plane. Change their order and the pipeline changes.
steps.say: see mm (breathe) kah bm (breathe) pee-nah-tah (breathe) dee
steps.explain: pi (×1), na (subtract a's 3), ta (keep above 3): only 4 is left. pitana keeps first, then subtracts: 1 2 3 4.
steps.task: Get 1 2 3 4 from the same start.

steps.title: Songs
steps.aid: A d-word of two or more syllables sings its own vowel line. demorini is e-o-i-i, the vowels of ego eimi, 'I am'.
steps.say: deh-moh-ree-nee
steps.explain: No plane changes: the word is a melody, Mercury, Mars, Sun, Sun.
steps.task: Sing a word whose vowels are a-i-a.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.aid: ! (tsk) puts a word ahead of the ring.
steps.say: see bm dee kee tsk rm
steps.explain: Without !, ring order would run si, ki, di and say 9. With ki! first, si then di say 1 2 3.
steps.task: Make 9 come out instead.

steps.title: Guard
steps.aid: ? (vvv) makes a word ask first: it runs only if i is positive.
steps.say: kee km (breathe) kah bm (breathe) kee-ah vvv (breathe) dee
steps.explain: i is 0, so kia? is skipped and 0 goes out.
steps.task: Change one number so that 3 comes out.

steps.title: Loops
steps.aid: l is Tishri, the turning of the year: repeat the next word.
steps.say: see pm (breathe) lee bm pee pm (breathe) dee
steps.explain: li #3 repeats pi #2 three times: 1 2 becomes 8 16.
steps.task: Double 1 to 2 five times.

steps.title: Sandbox
steps.aid: ~ (fff) wraps a word: if it fails, it is skipped and noted, and the program carries on.
steps.say: kee dm (breathe) fff see tm-km-km-km-km-km (breathe) dee
steps.explain: A stream of 248,832 values (#100000 is twelve to the fifth power) is over the limit; the sandbox skips it, so 4 goes out.
steps.task: Remove the sandbox and see the error, then put it back.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Calling a name
steps.aid: : (shh) calls a name. The Canon is the built-in library; :tame is the mean, :dasa says i.
steps.say: see gm (breathe) shh tah-meh (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: The mean of 1 to 5 is 3.
steps.task: Say the maximum of 1 to 8.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Defining a name, and while
steps.aid: ::name ... :: defines a word of your own. l with no number repeats while its plane is positive.
steps.example: ::kosu bogou nu #1 :: | ku #5 | ko #0 | lu :kosu | kio | di
steps.say: shh-shh koh-soo boh-goh-oo noo tm shh-shh (breathe) koo gm (breathe) koh km (breathe) loo shh koh-soo (breathe) kee-oh (breathe) dee
steps.explain: While u is positive: add u to o, take 1 from u. 5+4+3+2+1 = 15.
steps.task: Sum 7 down to 1 the same way.
steps.answer: ::kosu bogou nu #1 :: | ku #7 | ko #0 | lu :kosu | kio

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: The prelude
steps.aid: Some names are written in KANON itself: :kemu multiplies by repeated addition, :kegi is Euclid's algorithm, :kehi the factorial.
steps.say: kee mm (breathe) kah lm (breathe) shh keh-moo (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: 7 × 6 = 42, using only bind, gather, negate and a while-loop.
steps.task: Find the greatest common divisor of 84 and 36.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Number and letters
steps.aid: The Canon is laid out on the grid: k-names are number, t statistics, p geometry, b sequences, d doors, l logic, m music, r time, h seals.
steps.say: kee pm-rm (breathe) shh kah-pee (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: The primes up to 33. :dagi says numbers as Greek numerals, :dahe as Hebrew numerals.
steps.task: Say 23 as a Greek numeral.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Geometry and music
steps.aid: Star polygons, room resonances and string ratios are words of the language.
steps.say: kee nm (breathe) kah bm (breathe) shh pah-soh (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: The star {8/3}: visit every third of eight points: 0 3 6 1 4 7 2 5.
steps.task: List the first seven resonances of a cube room 10 metres on a side.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Time
steps.aid: Days count from 1 January 2000. :rado gives the planetary weekday (0 Sunday ... 6 Saturday); :raso the seven planetary longitudes.
steps.say: kee km (breathe) shh rah-doh (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: 1 January 2000 was a Saturday: 6, Saturn's day, the plane w.
steps.task: Which weekday was day 1?

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Speaking a program
steps.aid: = (zzz) carries error correction: five short parity words that repair any two misheard sounds in the verse and flag three or four.
steps.say: sah mm gee-ah tah bm zzz peh teh bee bay-ah poo-ah
steps.explain: Every verse can end with its parity words; the decoder repairs small mistakes and flags larger ones. In tests on spoken programs, none came back wrong without a flag.
steps.task: Run the ring program again.

steps.watch: Morning watch: names and the Canon
steps.title: Your own Euclid
steps.aid: Write the algorithm yourself: while a is positive, e = i mod a, i = a, a = e. Spell the body in ring order.
steps.example: ::kebo kei kia kae mea :: | ki #70 | ka #30 | la :kebo | :dasa
steps.say: shh-shh keh-boh keh-ee kee-ah kah-eh meh-ah shh-shh (breathe) kee mm-km (breathe) kah bm-km (breathe) lah shh keh-boh (breathe) shh dah-sah
steps.explain: kei kia kae mea runs as kei, mea, kia, kae (ring order). gcd(84, 36) = 12.
steps.task: Find gcd(105, 45) with your own name.
steps.answer: ::kebo kei kia kae mea :: | ki #89 | ka #39 | la :kebo
